title: Inches to Centimeters Converter: Feet & Inches to cm, and Back
description: Free inches to centimeters converter. Enter feet and inches to get cm, meters and millimeters, or turn cm back into feet and inches, using the exact 2.54 factor.
lead: How tall is 5 ft 9 in in centimeters? What is 175 cm in feet and inches? Enter your measurement and get the answer at once, with the exact factor of 2.54 cm per inch behind it.

sources.title: NIST Special Publication 811: Guide for the Use of the International System of Units (SI)
